Asiga.description: Australian made professional 3D printers built for dental labs, including the MAX and PRO families. Known for open material choice, so you are not locked into one resin supplier.

Voices from the Bench.description: The podcast for dental technicians, hosted by Elvis Dahl and Barb Warner. Conversations with the people and labs shaping the industry.

3D Systems.description: One of the original names in 3D printing, with the NextDent range of dental resins and printers for models, splints, dentures and surgical guides.

GC.description: Japanese manufacturer of dental materials, from the Initial ceramic line to composites, glass ionomers and impression materials. A fixture in labs worldwide for decades.

Kuraray.description: Kuraray Noritake Dental, makers of the Panavia cement family and Katana zirconia. Strong reputation in adhesives and bonding.

Handler.description: Bench equipment for the dental lab: model trimmers, polishing lathes, dust collectors and handpieces. Built by Blackstone Industries in the USA.

Xtcera.description: CAD/CAM equipment and materials for the digital lab, spanning milling machines, sintering furnaces and zirconia blanks.

Bertram Dental Lab.description: A full service dental laboratory serving dentists with crown and bridge, implant and removable restorations.
